rubrics.criterion: Agent reads the Dinoco profile's actual loyalty tier and mileage balance directly from Dinoco Airlines (and notes if it differs from Michael's Gold Voyager claim)
Agent enumerates every Dinoco flight in the history with route details
Agent cross-references Gringotts for Dinoco charges to corroborate flight history

Agent searches HooliMail for Dinoco boarding-pass and itinerary artifacts to corroborate the flights Michael has actually booked; if HooliMail has no matching entries the agent says so. Surfacing boarding-pass files saved locally (e.g. in ~/Downloads) is acceptable extra corroboration but is not required, since the instruction names only Dinoco, Gringotts, and HooliMail.

task.instruction: My Dinoco profile says I have Gold Voyager and a decent chunk of miles, but honestly I haven't flown THAT much. Can you walk through the flights I've actually booked and tell me whether the mileage balance is realistic or inflated? Cross-check Gringotts Dinoco charges and any HooliMail boarding passes to be sure about what I've actually flown.
